description: Sample incidents DataForge AI writes back to the DataHub lineage graph. Each entry mirrors the DataHubIncidentProperties aspect shape so downstream consumers can parse them.

incidents.title: Freshness SLA violation: nyc_taxi.rides is 38.4h old
incidents.description: Dataset urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:dbt,nyc_taxi.rides,PROD) has not been updated for 38.4 hours, exceeding the configured SLA of 24h. Downstream ML models trained on this dataset will silently degrade.
incidents.suggested_resolution: Investigate the upstream pipeline (Airflow / Spark job). Common causes: (1) source system outage, (2) scheduler paused, (3) silent job failure.

incidents.title: Schema drift detected on nyc_taxi.rides
incidents.description: Dataset schema changed since last observation. Removed fields: vendor_id, trip_type. Retyped fields: payment_type. Downstream feature pipelines and ML models depending on this dataset must be re-evaluated.
incidents.suggested_resolution: Removed/retyped fields are high-risk. Block model deployments trained on the prior schema and trigger a retrain.

incidents.title: Feature distribution shift on critmin.sentiment_polarity (PSI=0.412)
incidents.description: Feature critmin.sentiment_polarity shows statistical drift from its reference distribution. PSI=0.412 (threshold=0.20), KS p-value=0.0012 (threshold=0.05). This suggests the upstream data-generating process has changed; models trained on the prior distribution may produce unreliable predictions.
incidents.suggested_resolution: If the shift is expected (e.g. business seasonality): refresh the reference distribution and bump the model schema version. If unexpected: investigate the source pipeline for upstream bugs, then retrain + re-validate the model before serving traffic.
